name: Combinatorial Auction
summary: A multi-unit auction where bidders bid on bundles of items instead of individual items.
rules_text: There is a set of distinct items and several bidders. Each bidder has a private valuation for any bundle of items. Simultaneously, each bidder submits one or more bids, each bid consisting of a specific subset of items and a price offered for that exact subset. After all bids are revealed, the auctioneer solves the winner determination problem: choose a collection of bids that maximizes total offered price such that no item is allocated to more than one winning bid. Winning bidders pay their bid price and receive their bundle, losing bidders pay nothing. A bidder's payoff is valuation of bundle won minus price paid.
rating_reason: Combinatorial auction is strategic bidding with private values, implementable via numeric bids.
reasons: capability: needs something the manifest has no word for: bundle bidding
capability: needs something the manifest has no word for: winner determination optimization
